# ADE AGS 1.14.0

## Physical iPhone control
- Let agents inspect and control a paired physical iPhone or iPad through ADE's device controls, including touch, gestures, hardware buttons, and text input, with the existing permission and confirmation flow.
- Add nearby iPhone discovery over Wi-Fi and pause/resume controls for the ADE mirroring session while preserving device pairing.
- Improve paused-session layout, device selection, and mirrored viewport handling when the video frame changes orientation.

## Agent workflows
- Keep agent update notifications visible until the user dismisses them.
- Allow Jev to assist user-requested navigation when enabled and available, and guide agents to batch multi-screen routes and finish without unnecessary per-screen updates.
- Handle continuously animated screens without waiting for pixel-identical captures.
